transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I'm here because I just can't seem to keep my mind on one thing anymore. It's getting really frustrating at work. I'll be right in the middle of fixing a rendering bug, and... a Slack ping will go off, or I'll notice some color pattern on the screen, or even just hear a siren outside. And just like that, I'm pulled into a completely new idea before I even finish typing the line of code. It's just happening all the time lately.
Do you find yourself fidgeting or feeling restless when you're sitting still?

Yeah, definitely restless. It's like... I've been running on this constant current lately. The second I wake up, my brain is already going and I'm planning things out—new software features, exhibition layouts, press angles, code changes. It's all just happening at once. So, trying to just sit still... it honestly feels like I'm wasting the moment. I just feel like I need to be doing something.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?

Yeah, I guess I have been doing that. Like, recently... I spent some money we hadn't agreed on. I bought a bunch of new GPUs, print materials, and promo videos. And at work, I actually pushed an update without getting approval first. I just... waiting for another review cycle felt like letting the whole opportunity die, so I just went ahead and did it.
Do you have mood swings?

I guess you could say that. Most days lately, I just feel lit up and... completely unstoppable. It's like Glendale finally caught up with what I've been building. But then, yeah, I do get angry. I snap hard when my wife or my coworkers try to slow me down with what they call "process." I just don't have the patience for people dragging their feet right now.
Are you having trouble getting along with your wife or coworkers because of your behavior lately?

Yeah, it's definitely causing problems. At work, my employer actually put me on leave because of that update I pushed without approval. They weren't happy about me bypassing the process. And at home... things are pretty tense. My wife says all the money I've been spending and the arguments we've been having are making everything feel really unstable.
Have you always been like this, or is this a recent change for you?

No, it's... it's definitely a recent change. I haven't always been like this. I'd say this has been going on for about three months now. Yeah, roughly three months. It really all started right around the time my platform got selected for the Glendale showcase.
Have you noticed any significant difficulties with organizing tasks or activities?

No, I haven't really noticed any trouble with that. If anything, I... I feel like I'm completely on top of what needs to get done. I know exactly how to organize my work and my plans for the platform right now. It's just that I'm moving a lot faster than the usual process allows, so... no, organizing things hasn't been an issue for me at all.
Do you find yourself making careless mistakes in your work or other activities?

No, not really. I... I don't make careless mistakes. If anything, my code is probably better and more precise than it's ever been. The issue at work wasn't that my work was sloppy or wrong, it was just... you know, about the approval process. I knew exactly what I was doing. So no, I wouldn't say I'm making mistakes at all.
Do you think your recent behavior and symptoms have significantly impacted your ability to function effectively in your daily life or relationships?

Well, I suppose it has, yeah. I mean, my employer actually put me on administrative leave recently. I just... I bypassed the usual approval process and deployed some changes on my own because I knew they were right, but they didn't see it that way. And then at home, my wife... she says my spending lately and the arguments we've been having are making things feel really unstable for her. So, yeah, I guess it has impacted things.
Are you feeling overwhelmed or distressed by these changes in your behavior and thoughts?

Not really. I... I don't feel overwhelmed by my thoughts at all. Honestly, I feel pretty good. The only thing that's distressing is how other people are reacting to me right now. 

Like I said, I feel completely clear about what I'm doing and the changes I made, so it's just frustrating that my job and my wife don't see it that way. But my own mind and my behavior? No, that part isn't distressing me.
Do you have trouble paying attention to details in your work or daily activities?

No, I don't. It's... well, it's really just like what I was saying a minute ago about not making mistakes. I'm actually seeing the details better than ever. 

When I look at a block of code right now, I can see exactly how all the pieces fit together instantly. I don't miss anything. So, no, paying attention to details isn't a problem for me at all. I'd say I'm probably paying more attention to them than anyone else is.
Do you feel like you're struggling to cope with your current thoughts and behaviors?

No, I'm not struggling to cope at all. Like I was saying a minute ago, I actually feel really good. My thoughts are perfectly clear, and everything I'm doing makes complete sense to me right now. 

I don't feel like I'm struggling with myself or my own behavior. It's really just... I'm just having to deal with how everyone else is reacting to me. But as far as my own mind goes, no, I'm doing just fine.
Have you experienced an unusually elevated or irritable mood for most of the day over the past three months?

Well, elevated... yeah, I guess you could say that. Most days I just feel... lit up, you know? Completely unstoppable. It's like my mind is finally running at full capacity and the rest of the world, like my team in Glendale, is just now catching up to what I've been building all this time. 

But irritable? Yeah, that happens too. I mean, I feel great, but I snap pretty hard when people get in my way. Like my wife, or the guys at work... they keep trying to slow me down with all this talk about "process" and doing things the right way. It just gets so frustrating when they can't see the big picture and keep dragging their feet. So yeah, I get irritable when they do that.
Do you ever have days where you don't feel lit up or unstoppable?

No, not really. I mean, since this all started a few months ago, it's just been a constant high. I wake up feeling completely energized and ready to go, and it just stays like that. I haven't really had any down days or times where I felt slow or tired. It's just been this steady, intense drive every single day.
Have you been sleeping less than usual over the past three months?

I guess I haven't really noticed any change in my sleep. I mean, I'm not really sure if I'm sleeping less than usual. I still go to bed and get up... I just haven't been paying that much attention to the exact hours, to be honest. I just know I wake up feeling ready to go.
Do you feel like you're more important or special than you used to?

Yeah, I do. I mean... I honestly feel like I'm the only one who can connect generative art, Mexican visual traditions, and the tech community. I just see how they all fit together, and I know I can do it in a way that could completely change how the city sees public art. So, yeah, I definitely feel like I have a special purpose right now that nobody else really has.
